event_data.context: Add a manually triggered GitHub release workflow for a green main revision using an app-scoped deploy token. Deploy existing production Docker entrypoint on one always-on Machine in sjc, 0.0.0.0:3000 behind HTTPS, persisted /data volume and Managed Postgres Basic in sjc via direct TLS. Provision stable master key, scoped runtime credentials, verified company Google SSO email-domain allowlist, and team OpenAI project access using Fly secrets. Use gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17. Verify the released commit, authenticated turn, and a tool-call smoke. Store no credentials in the board.
event_data.summary: Release green main to one always-on Fly Machine with HTTPS, persistent storage, team Google SSO, and the team OpenAI API project.
